page_title: WHU 2-0 LEI | West Ham v Leicester 27/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
90+3' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+1' Emerson (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Mads Hermansen comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Andrew Irving (West Ham) replaces Tomas Soucek.
90' A lofted cross from Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
89' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
87' Ruud van Nistelrooy decides to make a substitution. Victor Kristiansen will be replaced by Luke Thomas (Leicester).
87' A substitution has been made. Jannik Vestergaard goes off and Patson Daka (Leicester) comes on.
86' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
83' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
82' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Stephy Mavididi (Leicester).
81' He should have scored! Evan Ferguson (West Ham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
79' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
77' West Ham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
73' Substitution. Evan Ferguson (West Ham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mohammed Kudus walks off.
73' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
70' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

68' Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His precise header looks to be going under the crossbar, but Alphonse Areola is alert and somehow manages to keep the ball out.
68' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leicester.
68' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
66' Graham Potter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Soler (West Ham) replacing Edson Alvarez.
66' Here comes a substitution. Jean-Clair Todibo is given a rest as he is replaced by Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
65' Oliver Scarles will be replaced by Emerson (West Ham).
62' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
61' That's the end of the game for Boubakary Soumare, who is replaced by Harry Winks (Leicester).
61' Ruud van Nistelrooy prepares a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid is replaced by Stephy Mavididi (Leicester).

61' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
59' The ball goes behind for a corner. Leicester will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
56' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
55' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
53' The Leicester players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
51' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
49' A player from West Ham commits a rough challenge. Anthony Taylor blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
46' The whistle blows and Anthony Taylor starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and James Justin (Leicester) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 0 OWN GOAL! Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 2:0.
43' The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
42' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
38' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes.

35' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by West Ham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
26' West Ham fail to score from a corner as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaps to collect the ball.
21' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

21' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mads Hermansen pulls off an easy save.
20' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
19' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
18' A pass into the penalty area from Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is intercepted by the defence.
17' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' It looks like Max Kilman (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
8' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
7' Neat passing move from West Ham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Alphonse Areola.
2' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The ball is out of play. Leicester win a corner kick.
1' James Justin (Leicester) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Leicester will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
